    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==5]
    def near(p):
        r,c=p
        return sum(1 for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=r+dr<len(grid) and 0<=c+dc<len(grid[0]) and grid[r+dr][c+dc]!=0)

    dst=marks[1] if marks[0]==src else marks[0]
    dr,dc=dst[0]-src[0],dst[1]-src[1]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,x in enumerate(row):
            if x and (r,c) not in marks:
